baseline.note: Patient presents with acute onset abdominal pain starting around the umbilicus yesterday evening, now localized to the right lower quadrant. Describes constant ache, 7/10, worsened by walking and coughing. Associated symptoms: one episode of vomiting this morning, anorexia, possible low-grade fever, no diarrhea, constipation since yesterday, no dysuria, no urinary symptoms. No significant past medical or surgical history except tonsillectomy. No regular medications; took two paracetamol today. Negative pregnancy test last week. Physical exam: tenderness and guarding in the right lower quadrant, otherwise soft abdomen. Family history notable for cousin with appendectomy. Impression: likely acute appendicitis. Plan: referral to surgical team for further evaluation and management.
